title: Anakin Skywalker's Podracer
description: Built in secret, away from the prying eyes of Watto, Anakin Skywalker constructed what he thought to be the fastest podracer ever built. Painted to a shiny silver and blue sheen with bright yellow fins and a vibrant purple energy binder, the podracer was a stunning sight. The young human—the only such being in the sport—took to the starting line at the Boonta Eve Classic in his custom built racer and showed everyone at the Mos Espa Grand Arena exactly what it could do. Not only did he finish his race in first place, but he beat Sebulba in the process.
